title: Vouchor
summary: VOUCHOR, noun In law, the tenant in a writ of right; one who calls in another to establish his warranty of title . In common recoveries, there may be a single voucher, or double vouchers.

inlines.v: VOUCHOR, noun In law, the tenant in a writ of right; one who calls in another to establish his warranty of title . In common recoveries, there may be a single voucher, or double vouchers.
